verdict.rationale: Cloudflare AI Gateway is a SaaS gateway service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official MCP server for AI Gateway. The llms.txt and OpenAPI probes are adjacent developer resources, not an MCP server, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
